entities.name: Moukir
entities.description: Human knight, captain of the Knights of the Pilgrim’s Road, from Valeron in Bant, who met Gideon after his first planeswalk.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who arrived on Bant after his first planeswalk and was mistakenly named Gideon.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: Bant nation where Gideon was lost.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Moukir lives.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Only place where Gideon's original name remained known.

events.summary: Moukir and her leotau mount encounter Gideon just as he appears on Bant after his first planeswalk.
events.quote: Moukir and her leotau mount encountered Gideon Jura just as he appeared on Bant

events.summary: Moukir guesses the name Gideon from his choked-out Kytheon; he is too overwhelmed to correct her, and his name changes to everyone outside Theros.
events.quote: his name changed to everyone outside of Theros

relations.quote: captain of the Knights of the Pilgrim’s Road
